title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: drop an explained union head from a refused save's issues only when it is zod's bare "Invalid input"

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgRuogP8Tp8XyFXLc92Bxvo6)_

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Fixes #35400

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc teaches the order of a refused metadata save's `issues`, or its union entry (searched `skills/` and `content/docs/` for `invalid_union`, "Invalid input", `issues[0]` and "strictly additive"; the hits describe the data API's `fields[]` and the UI CLI's validate report, both unchanged here)

## 维护者速读

1. 设计器、接口或 AI 助手保存元数据被拒时,清单里那句什么都没说的「输入无效」不再排在真正原因前面,第一条直接指出是哪个键错了;自带修法说明的条目照旧保留。
2. 这是巡检发现的「视图或表单保存被拒时,清单第一行是一句空话」的问题,按您两次裁定的范围执行:每一层都去掉,但只去真正空的那句。
3. 出错时,设计器约 25 个字段在保存被拒后少一行「输入无效」红字(多数在作者下次改动后恢复,表单另开一张单改),按第几条读清单的外部调用方会读到另一条;不丢数据也不影响权限,回退代码即可恢复,但发版后回退等于接口再变一次。
4. 无。

## What changes

- **The rule** (`collectMetadataIssues`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-metadata-issues.ts`): a union's own entry (the head) is dropped only when BOTH hold: the branch expansion appended at least one entry, and the head's message is exactly zod's default for a failed union. Every other head stays, ahead of what it explains: a head carrying the schema's own sentence (the template slot's sentence telling the author to write a template string, an action's `confirmText` sentence, a view's retirement prescription), a head nothing below explains (every branch a bare kind mismatch, zod's empty `errors`, the depth bound), and every container head (`invalid_key`, `invalid_element`). This narrows the round-1 WIP (`b277779bd0`), which dropped every explained head whatever its message.
- **One named constant** for the compared text, `ZOD_UNION_DEFAULT_MESSAGE` (module-level export, not re-exported by `protocol.ts`), pinned against a real zod parse (plain `z.union` and the real view schema), so a zod rewording fails a test instead of silently turning the drop off.
- **Texts that became false move here:** the producer's entry-rule docblock (and the WIP's "carries no prescription" line, measured false), the `zodIssuesToMetadataIssues` docblock, and the read-path comment in `metadata-diagnostics.ts` that said the union entry stays first.
- **All four callers move together** (save `422 INVALID_METADATA`, read `_diagnostics.errors`, seed-request refusal, unmanaged-import `400`): they share the one producer.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/metadata-issues-bare-union-head.md`: `patch`, both declaration lines, BREAKING banner, a was/now table, "read entries by `path` and `code`, not by index", one ADR-0087 marker (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; the gate accepted it), what stays, the deliberate asymmetry, and the known regression below.
- **The asymmetry, recorded** in `union-branch-policy.cross-package-parity.test.ts`: this envelope drops an explained bare head; the terminal renderer keeps it as its parent row; the data API's `fields[]` keeps it as `invalid_shape` (#35433 tracks it). §2 still compares branch selection across all three walks, with exactly those heads projected out of the two spec walks; §4 asserts the asymmetry itself and that an unexplained bare head is kept by all three.
- **Not here:** no `ui/` change (Studio's form rows are #35499) and no change to `packages/spec/src/api/zod-issues-to-fields.ts` (#35433).

**Known regression, until #35499 lands.** Studio's metadata form draws a refusal's entry on a field row only when the entry's path equals the row's key. On about 25 top-level keys the dropped head was the only entry at that exact path, so after a refused save that row shows one red line fewer (the "Invalid input" line). On a type with a live validator the author's next edit redraws the row; on the rest (the seat's analysis counted 9 keys) it stays off until #35499. The place is still named by the entries themselves and in the Save button's tooltip.

## Tests

Readings are on this branch after its one merge of `origin/main` `5756ae0d75`; the code head was `62387026db`; the final head `692d874e93` adds a merge of `origin/main` `94fb8db2d1` and a changeset-only commit (the Clause-② line reads `no (narrowing)`). The code head's last commit only adds a module-top preload import to four pin files (Verification), so the five pin files and the package typecheck were re-run on it: 122 passed, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

- **Moved pins: 22 tests in the five files** went red on the producer change alone and were rewritten (save-union-issues 7, cross-package parity 8, 422 face inventory 3, container descent 2, diagnostics 2). That is the same 22 the WIP rule moved: every moved pin's head was zod's bare text, so the bare-only condition moved none back.
- **New pins** (one `describe` in `protocol.save-union-issues.test.ts`, the file's shared harness): the zod text pin; synthetic bare-vs-authored; a refused view save with a non-locale `label` map answers only the two `label.not_a_locale` entries, container head first; an object `titleFormat` and an action `confirmText` written as formulas keep their authored heads ahead of the `.dialect` cause; CONTROL `label: 42` keeps its unexplained bare head. Plus §4's asymmetry pin in the parity file.

## Acceptance notes

- Studio was measured from source in round 1 and in the seat's scope analysis, not driven in a browser; the form change is #35499.
- The data API's `fields[]` keeps its `invalid_shape` head (#35433); the CLI and terminal renderer keep the parent line. Both are pinned as deliberate.
- A union head whose message is the schema's own sentence is kept even when its sentence is repeated on an entry below (for example a view's retirement prescription, which also rides on the retired key's own entry). Bare-only was ruled over "drop when repeated below".

## Verification

Local subset on the code head `62387026db` (the final head `692d874e93` adds only a merge of main and a changeset line; CI on it: 39 success, 18 skipped, 0 failed): the derived list (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 66 families) all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation over the recorded exits: "66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN" (a derived zero: all 66 recorded an exit code and none is 3).

- One family was red on the head before last and is answered in the diff: `check:test-source-alias` judged the four edited pin files that reach the protocol's lazy lint import inside a clocked case. They now import the package's existing lint preload testkit at module top, as `protocol.save-union-issues.test.ts` already does; the gate then read "the source reach judged 5 test file(s) changed", OK.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` exited 3 (prerequisite, no `dist/`) on the first run; on the final head, after the dogfood closure build, both exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=claude/issue-35400-drop-explained-union-wrapper` before every push: "VERDICT clean exit 0", 0 PR heads overlapping.
- Families CI owns (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Build Core`, the UI lanes) are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run locally.

- Read first: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-metadata-issues.ts` (the one-line rule in `collectMetadataIssues`, and the constant), then `union-branch-policy.cross-package-parity.test.ts` (`withoutExplainedBareHeads` and §4), then the changeset.

- Line budget: 8 files, +360 / -88 (the changeset +32; production code +72 / -30 in two files; the rest is tests).
